_comment: Copy to ~/.cherrypick/config/console.json. Every key is optional: a missing file, or a missing key, means the default shown here. The console reads this file at start, so restart it after an edit.

serve._note: The port the console listens on (it binds 127.0.0.1 only). The default is not 5060 or 5061, which Chrome blocks. An invalid number means the default.

_update_check_note: Anything but a literal false means on: the console asks GitHub for the latest release about every six hours, for the status bar's version chip. false stops the request.
_live_arming_note: Off unless this is the literal true. When true, MEIC's main account and the ladder get an arm-for-today switch on the Live page's today tab, behind the module's own readiness, the disclaimer and a typed YES. The console never clears the halt flag and places no order. The slash commands and live_loop --arm work either way.
